description: Review recently changed code for reuse opportunities, quality issues, and efficiency problems, then fix them. Use when: (1) user asks to "simplify", "clean up", or "review" changed code, (2) after implementing a feature to check for over-engineering, (3) code smell detection — duplication, unnecessary abstractions, dead branches, verbose patterns. Keywords: simplify, clean up, refactor, review changes, code quality, over-engineered, duplication, dead code, git diff, after feature, reuse, typescript, type assertion, async, barrel export. Diff-scoped only (recent changes). For whole-codebase dead code removal, use reducing-entropy.
